purpose: Isolate supersampling factor from reconstruction/downsample changes after the initial H45 exploration confounded both variables.

constantPipeline.geometry: same approved placement plan at every factor

interpretation: Once reconstruction and downsample filters are held constant, 4x->8x produces no material placement-scale benefit in either rotated elongated-hardware case.
1x->4x still changes antialiasing materially enough to justify a moderate supersampling fixture.
The earlier apparent 4x->8x H45 gain was confounded by simultaneous filter/downsample changes and must not be used as evidence for an 8x policy.
Normalized factual coverage remains stable across factors; the differences are sampling behavior, not factual content gain.

decision.nextQuestion: Separate internal sampling working scale from deliverable master-asset dimensions before freezing the renderer architecture.

provenanceNote: Real-source factor isolation was measured with an independent numerical harness reproducing the committed sampler equations over the exact source readbacks. The committed JS sampler itself is separately validated by raster-quality-self-test.v1.json.
